description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' [[File:Health regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Health regeneration]] regenerates an additional「 0.4% – 2.3% (based on level) of his [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''maximum''' health every 5 seconds. 」「 0.04% – 0.23% (based on level) of his [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''maximum''' health every 0.5 seconds. 」
description.text: Innate: Dr. Mundo  regenerates an additional「 0.4% – 2.3% (based on level) of his  maximum health every 5 seconds. 」「 0.04% – 0.23% (based on level) of his  maximum health every 0.5 seconds. 」

description2.raw: '''Passive:''' Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilizing]] effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a health cost equal to 4% of his '''current''' health and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.
description2.text: Passive: Periodically, Dr. Mundo gains immunity to the next hostile immobilizing effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, Dr. Mundo pays a health cost equal to 4% of his current health and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.

description3.raw: '''Dr. Mundo''' can move near the canister to consume it, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] himself for 4% of his '''maximum''' health and reducing the [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown of ''Goes Where He Pleases'' by 15 seconds. Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] can move near it to destroy it.
description3.text: Dr. Mundo can move near the canister to consume it, healing himself for 4% of his maximum health and reducing the  cooldown of Goes Where He Pleases by 15 seconds. Enemy champions can move near it to destroy it.

description4.raw: ''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].
description4.text: Goes Where He Pleases' cooldown resets upon respawning.

notes.raw: * Upon being triggered by a hostile [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilizing]] effect, ''Goes Where He Pleases'' will also grant '''Dr. Mundo''' immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same [[:Champion ability|cast instance]]. ** Abilities where non-immobilizing effects and damage are nested into immobilizing ones will have them also prevented. Non-immobilizing effects and damage applied separately (the vast majority of cases) are not prevented. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] and [[File:Morgana Black Shield.png|20xpx|border|link=Morgana#Black Shield|An icon for Morgana's ability Black Shield]] [[Morgana#Black Shield|Black Shield]] take priority over ''Goes Where He Pleases''. * The canister, whether in flight and on the ground, will transition in and out of [[File:Mordekaiser OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Mordekaiser|An icon representing Mordekaiser]] [[Mordekaiser|Mordekaiser's]] [[File:Mordekaiser Realm of Death.png|20xpx|border|link=Mordekaiser#Realm of Death|An icon for Mordekaiser's ability Realm of Death]] [[Mordekaiser#Realm of Death|Death Realm]] alongside ''Dr. Mundo''.(unexpected) * The canister cannot be interacted with while [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]].
notes.text:
Upon being triggered by a hostile immobilizing effect, Goes Where He Pleases will also grant Dr. Mundo immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same cast instance.
* Abilities where non-immobilizing effects and damage are nested into immobilizing ones will have them also prevented. Non-immobilizing effects and damage applied separately (the vast majority of cases) are not prevented.
Spell shield and Black Shield take priority over Goes Where He Pleases.
The canister, whether in flight and on the ground, will transition in and out of Mordekaiser's Death Realm alongside Dr. Mundo.(unexpected)
The canister cannot be interacted with while untargetable.
